integrity: The algebraic proof and exact-rational verifier are included. Publication priority is subject to possible earlier unindexed treatments. The older potentially relevant conditionals-commutativity article could not be read in full.
scientific_limitations: All four atoms must have strictly positive mass; all norms are real L-infinity. No statement is made for general finite partitions, arbitrary Lp, or fixed margins. The 2008-07-23 date is the verified public posting of the specific 2x2 odds-ratio source; older qualitative projection work is cited by year.
title: Sharp odds-ratio control of the order defect of two binary conditional expectations
